title: Returning this
text: Returning this. I am returning this bag, not because there is anything wrong with it, but it does not explicitly say on the picture description that it has a separation right in the middle of it, the separation could even be useful if it wasn't because I found it very inconvenient that this bag is huge and very heavy material, the handles are awesome and make it easy to carry around but if you take into account the amount of clothes you want to carry on this alongside with the actual bag that is so heavy because of the material it is made out of I'd say this is a no go for me. I honestly am returning it because I had no idea it had that middle separation in the first place before I bought it, but there is also the issue with how heavy it really is and how difficult it is to store. Honestly it just takes up a lot of space as well, the material looks sturdy and like it will last a long time but it just makes it all the more difficult to actually store this anywhere in any other shape in which it already is, which just makes it annoying for me. I am thinking the only good thing about this bag is the handles, and the size mostly, and well if you like the idea of having a separation in the middle then that could be a plus as well, just not for me.
